Transcript:
You're listening to Radio Station WKXL. Turning to local business updates, Monday marked the official opening of Starbright Corporation's newest manufacturing plant right here in Millfield. Starbright, renowned nationwide for its line of athletic footwear, expects this five-million-dollar facility to create more than three hundred new jobs by the end of the fiscal year. Company executives stated that the plant utilizes state-of-the-art automated machinery to assemble sneakers using recycled rubber and organic textiles. If you're interested in applying for a position, HR representatives will be holding a series of video interviews throughout this month. Visit starbright.com/careers to book your interview slot.

questions.text: What did Starbright Corporation recently do?
questions.explanation: Phát thanh viên đưa tin: 'Monday marked the official opening of Starbright Corporation's newest manufacturing plant...' (nhà máy sản xuất mới). Chọn (B) It opened a new factory.

questions.text: What type of product does Starbright Corporation make?
questions.explanation: Bản tin nhắc đến: 'renowned nationwide for its line of athletic footwear... assemble sneakers'. Chọn (A) Footwear.

questions.text: What is available online?
questions.explanation: Người nói thông báo: 'HR representatives will be holding a series of video interviews throughout this month. Visit starbright.com/careers to book your interview slot.' Chọn (C) A video interview.

Thank you all for coming to this celebration. I know I speak for everyone here at Apex Advertising when I say how much we will miss working alongside Mustafa Perez. Over his thirty-five years with our agency, Mustafa has directed campaigns for some of the biggest brand names in the world. He has been a mentor, a leader, and a dear friend to countless colleagues. While we are sad to see him retire, we are excited for his upcoming travels across Europe. To commemorate tonight, our graphic design department created a personalized slideshow chronicling his most iconic advertisements. Let's dim the lights and enjoy the retrospective.

questions.text: What event is taking place?
questions.explanation: Người nói chia sẻ: 'how much we will miss working alongside Mustafa Perez... While we are sad to see him retire...'. Đây là bữa tiệc chia tay nghỉ hưu. Chọn (D) A retirement party.

questions.text: What type of business does Mustafa Perez work for?
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc đến: 'everyone here at Apex Advertising... Over his thirty-five years with our agency...'. Chọn (C) An advertising agency.

questions.text: What has the speaker created for the event?
questions.explanation: Người nói giới thiệu: 'our graphic design department created a personalized slideshow chronicling his most iconic advertisements.' Chọn (A) A slideshow.

The last point on our safety meeting agenda concerns the cleanroom protocols at our pharmaceutical laboratory. As manufacturers of prescription medications, maintaining strict sterile conditions is non-negotiable. Recently, our compliance officers noticed that several technicians failed to secure their hairnets and protective footwear before entering Cleanroom B. Please remember that contamination risks could ruin entire production batches. We ask all shift supervisors to inspect their teams before each entry. You can review the updated safety manual and equipment donning procedures directly on our staff intranet portal.

questions.text: What does the speaker's company produce?
questions.explanation: Người nói nêu rõ: 'cleanroom protocols at our pharmaceutical laboratory. As manufacturers of prescription medications...'. Chọn (A) Medications.

questions.text: What are the listeners reminded to do?
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc nhở nhân viên tuân thủ quy trình phòng sạch: 'maintaining strict sterile conditions... inspect their teams before each entry'. Chọn (D) Follow safety procedures.

questions.text: What can be found online?
questions.explanation: Người nói kết luận: 'You can review the updated safety manual and equipment donning procedures directly on our staff intranet portal.' Cẩm nang/sổ tay an toàn (manual / handbook). Chọn (C) A handbook.

Hi, Aisha. I'm here at Oakridge Park setting up our booth for the weekend farmer's market. I just unloaded all the crates of fresh organic strawberries and blueberries we picked yesterday. Everything looks fantastic, though I did accidentally forget the canopy tent we normally use to shield the produce. I know you're worried about the berries spoiling in direct heat, but it's supposed to be cloudy all day, so they should stay cool and fresh without any problem. Anyway, the main reason I called was to remind you to submit our entry form for the regional agriculture competition by noon today. I really think our berries have a winning shot this year.

questions.text: What will the speaker do at a park?
questions.explanation: Người nói đang ở quầy chợ nông sản bán dâu tây và việt quất: 'setting up our booth for the weekend farmer's market... crates of fresh organic strawberries and blueberries'. Chọn (B) Sell fruit.

questions.text: Why does the speaker say, "but it's supposed to be cloudy all day"?
questions.explanation: Người nghe lo hoa quả bị hỏng do nắng nóng khi quên mang lều bạt, người nói trấn an rằng trời râm mát cả ngày nên không sao: 'I know you're worried... but it's supposed to be cloudy all day, so they should stay cool'. Chọn (D) To reassure the listener.

questions.text: What does the speaker remind the listener to do?
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc nhở: 'remind you to submit our entry form for the regional agriculture competition by noon today.' Đăng ký tham gia cuộc thi. Chọn (A) Register for a competition.

Attention, all assembly line staff here at Highland Furniture Factory. Please be aware that our electronic time-tracking system is currently offline due to a server malfunction. That means you won't be able to swipe your ID badges at the digital kiosks when clocking out at the end of your shift today. Instead, please report to the receptionist's desk in the main lobby and sign the paper attendance sheet before exiting the building. Our network engineering team is working on the problem, and they assure us that the software will be fully operational by tomorrow morning. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

questions.text: Where is the announcement being made?
questions.explanation: Thông báo mở đầu: 'Attention, all assembly line staff here at Highland Furniture Factory.' (nhà máy nội thất). Chọn (C) At a factory.

questions.text: Where should the listeners go at the end of their shifts?
questions.explanation: Người nói hướng dẫn: 'Instead, please report to the receptionist's desk in the main lobby and sign the paper attendance sheet...'. Chọn (B) To the receptionist's desk.

questions.text: What will happen tomorrow?

options.A: Some office furniture will be delivered.
options.B: New board members will be elected.
options.C: A city official will conduct an inspection.
options.D: Some time-reporting software will be fixed.

questions.explanation: Người nói thông báo: 'they assure us that the software will be fully operational by tomorrow morning.' Phần mềm chấm công sẽ được khắc phục xong. Chọn (D) Some time-reporting software will be fixed.

The final item on our staff meeting agenda concerns the upcoming Community Health Expo next Saturday. As a family medical clinic, we've had an informational booth at this event for five consecutive years. However, since Nurse Jenkins recently retired, we currently do not have anyone designated to organize our health screening materials and oversee the volunteers. We need one staff member to step forward and take charge of coordinating our booth. The clinic will provide complimentary catered lunches for everyone who participates, and you'll receive overtime pay for your hours on Saturday.

questions.text: Where do the listeners work?
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc đến: 'As a family medical clinic, we've had an informational booth...' (phòng khám y tế gia đình). Chọn (D) At a medical clinic.

questions.text: What does the speaker imply when she says, "Nurse Jenkins has retired"?

options.A: A role needs to be filled.
options.B: An e-mail will not be answered.
options.C: A marketing strategy should be revised.
options.D: A process will be less efficient.

questions.explanation: Người nói giải thích lý do hiện tại chưa có người phụ trách gian hàng vì cô Jenkins đã nghỉ hưu, ngụ ý cần ai đó đảm nhận vị trí này: 'we currently do not have anyone designated... We need one staff member to step forward'. Chọn (A) A role needs to be filled.

questions.text: What will be provided for those who volunteer?
questions.explanation: Người nói nêu đãi ngộ: 'The clinic will provide complimentary catered lunches for everyone who participates...' (bữa ăn trưa miễn phí). Chọn (C) A meal.

As you know, the advertising business is very competitive, and keeping NVC satisfied is vital for our agency's quarterly revenue. I wanted to let you know that I've invited Isabel to join us for dinner. Since she was recently promoted to Senior Account Executive, she'll be taking over daily communications with NVC starting next month. Could you please call the restaurant and add one more person to our table reservation? Let me know once the reservation has been updated.

questions.explanation: Người gọi nhắc đến: 'our upcoming client dinner with NVC Industries this Friday evening'. Bữa tối làm việc với khách hàng. Chọn (C) A client meeting.

questions.text: Why does the speaker say, "the advertising business is very competitive"?

options.A: To explain a decision to retire
options.D: To emphasize the importance of a client

questions.explanation: Người nói nhấn mạnh sự cạnh tranh gay gắt nhằm giải thích tại sao việc giữ chân khách hàng lớn NVC lại quan trọng sống còn: 'and keeping NVC satisfied is vital for our agency's quarterly revenue'. Chọn (D) To emphasize the importance of a client.

questions.text: What does the speaker say about Isabel?

options.A: She has recently joined the company.
options.D: She used to work on the NVC Industries account.

questions.explanation: Người nói cho biết: 'Since she was recently promoted to Senior Account Executive...' (vừa mới được thăng chức). Chọn (B) She was recently promoted.

Good morning, team. Over the past six months, our grocery chain has invested heavily in developing a home grocery delivery app. However, data shows that only fifteen percent of our regular supermarket customers have downloaded and placed orders through the app. Customers seem hesitant because they prefer selecting their own produce in person. To overcome this hurdle, our marketing team plans to upload a series of short demonstration videos to our website and social media channels. The videos will highlight how our personal shoppers carefully inspect and select only the freshest fruits and vegetables for each delivery order.

questions.text: What is the speaker concerned about?

options.D: A Web site is not working.

questions.explanation: Người nói lo lắng vì khách hàng chưa chịu dùng dịch vụ mới: 'only fifteen percent of our regular supermarket customers have downloaded and placed orders through the app'. Chọn (B) Low adoption of a service.

questions.text: What does the speaker plan to do?

options.D: Add videos to a Web site

questions.explanation: Người nói công bố kế hoạch: 'our marketing team plans to upload a series of short demonstration videos to our website...'. Chọn (D) Add videos to a Web site.

Hello, Mr. Harris. This is Nadia calling from Crestview Auto Dealership. I've been finalizing the documentation for the pre-owned sedan you purchased yesterday. When you come in to pick up the keys, you'll need to settle the administrative fees listed on your closing sheet. Please note that while most charges can be paid by credit card, the one-hundred-dollar fee must be paid strictly in cash or money order. Once everything is finalized, your official vehicle title will be processed and mailed to your home address within ten days. Don't forget that your purchase includes complimentary car washes at our facility for six months. Just show your customer account barcode to the attendant.

questions.text: Look at the graphic. Which fee must be paid in cash?

questions.text: What service does the speaker remind the listener about?
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc nhở: 'Don't forget that your purchase includes complimentary car washes at our facility for six months.' (dịch vụ rửa xe miễn phí). Chọn (C) Free car washes.

Transcript:
Welcome to this morning's staff meeting at Helgen's Music Shop. First, to celebrate our store's tenth anniversary and draw new foot traffic, we'll be hosting a local talent contest in September. I've already confirmed three regional musicians who have agreed to serve as guest judges. Second, take a look at the pie chart from our annual sales report on the screen. While guitars and keyboards continue to generate strong revenue, look at the slice representing twenty units sold. Pianos account for only twenty sales the entire year, yet they occupy nearly forty percent of our display showroom floor. Consequently, management has decided to discontinue stocking acoustic pianos and reallocate that floor space to band instruments and rental gear.

questions.text: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.explanation: Người nói phát biểu trong cuộc họp nhân viên tại cửa hàng nhạc cụ: 'staff meeting at Helgen's Music Shop... management has decided' (quản lý cửa hàng). Chọn (C) A shop manager.

questions.text: What event will take place in September?
questions.explanation: Người nói thông báo: 'we'll be hosting a local talent contest in September.' Chọn (D) A talent contest.

questions.text: Look at the graphic. Which type of instrument does the speaker focus on?
questions.explanation: Người nói chỉ vào phần có số lượng 20 chiếc bán ra: 'look at the slice representing twenty units sold. Pianos account for only twenty sales the entire year... discontinue stocking acoustic pianos'. Nhìn vào biểu đồ tròn, 20 ứng với Pianos. Chọn (B) Pianos.
